title: salix gracilistyla f. adscendens
intro: Salix gracilistyla f. adscendens, commonly known as White Willow, is a plant species that belongs to the Salicaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of White Willow include its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve pain, making it a popular choice for treating conditions such as arthritis and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of White Willow include salicin, a compound that has been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects, while its therapeutic actions also include reducing fever and acting as an antiseptic.
